event_definition: Workflow submit/schedule/image-stage/job create/start/stop; executor and recorder ownership
collection_source_and_method: Owner orchestration lifecycle export and outside-job supervisor; no OSMO identity guessed
clock_domain_and_mapping: Workflow native UTC plus host boot/monotonic brackets; receipt clock separately
known_limit: Outer workflow identity/time absent historically; native runtime capability owner-dependent

event_definition: Isaac init begin/app-ready/application-complete with source and receipt
collection_source_and_method: Reviewed async Isaac hooks plus unmodified raw logs
clock_domain_and_mapping: Process steady ns/native producer realtime; Docker/log receipt separate if used
known_limit: App-ready is not scene/PX4 readiness; receipt precision not acquisition accuracy

event_definition: Stage/asset open/fetch/cache/shader begin/end and simulator/physics init
collection_source_and_method: Frozen stage/asset hooks, cache manifest and actual CPU/GPU/I/O counters
clock_domain_and_mapping: Simulator producer steady ns, scene epoch and distinct simulation time
known_limit: Exclusive scene versus broad interval needs explicit subspans; remote asset dependency unresolved

event_definition: Vehicle graph available and first Play/backend evaluation/spawn request boundary
collection_source_and_method: Graph/first-Play/back-end transition hooks with parent-event references
clock_domain_and_mapping: Same process steady ns; reset/first-Play/graph instance IDs
known_limit: Historical graph log alone cannot prove first-Play or child readiness

event_definition: PX4 spawn request/return/exec birth/rcS begin/end and firmware ready semantic event
collection_source_and_method: Approved parent hook plus child lifecycle/boot logs and exact process/binary/parameter IDs
clock_domain_and_mapping: Spawner steady ns; host boot ticks/rate; PX4 boot clock separately with map
known_limit: Spawn return/process existence/startup script/commander-ready are distinct; no physical readiness claim

event_definition: MAVLink endpoint bind/connect/retry and first heartbeat emission/receive per endpoint
collection_source_and_method: Receive-only endpoint/native hooks and separately approved bounded filtered capture; no injector
clock_domain_and_mapping: Endpoint steady/capture clock and PX4 source clock identified/mapped; kernel receipt separately
known_limit: Cannot infer wire latency without emitter/mapping; TCP/Pegasus and companion paths distinct

event_definition: First MAVROS packet, connected-state publish and corresponding subscription receipt
collection_source_and_method: MAVROS/plugin and receiver hook with packet/source/GID sequence and raw producer logs
clock_domain_and_mapping: Process native steady ns plus ROS header/domain; publication versus callback receipt separate
known_limit: Historical first-heartbeat interval is log arithmetic; reconnects not new startups

event_definition: DDS participant/endpoint discovery match, QoS/security identity and callback receipt
collection_source_and_method: Reviewed RMW/DDS trace with exact version/profiles/permissions and bounded async writer
clock_domain_and_mapping: Native DDS monotonic clock per producer/boot with calibrated cross-process map
known_limit: XML/domain/socket existence is not discovery latency; platform trace/security capability unverified

event_definition: Guard actual state/extended-state callbacks, source/receipt age, Set/Get request/result/type/value, attempted/initialized/unsafe/readiness/latch transitions
collection_source_and_method: Native guard transition hooks and actual safe-state/parameter traffic; no synthetic priming or manual repair
clock_domain_and_mapping: Original guard std::chrono::steady_clock ns, producer/receipt clocks distinct
known_limit: Do not claim full trace from later false samples, source code or config-file scaling value

event_definition: Guard member-construction steady origin, timer scheduled/actual/lock/elapsed and deadline comparison/error
collection_source_and_method: Exact source/hook/binary map, before-constructor-body semantic marker and bounded async events
clock_domain_and_mapping: Same guard steady ns; optional independently bounded UTC map; never simulator clock
known_limit: Numeric origin unrecorded historically; cannot subtract observed10s from error to fabricate origin; requirement allocation missing

collection_source_and_method: Dedicated owner-approved resource counter sampler and independent supervisor health/OS statuses
clock_domain_and_mapping: Host/process monotonic samples mapped to event spans, actual cadence and uncertainty
known_limit: Current pressure/capacity cannot reconstruct startup load or prove causality; independent survival unverified
